candidate.rationale: Restore the surrogate-pair end adjustment (already present) and add the missing start-boundary check: an offset that begins between the high and low halves of a surrogate pair must fail with 'inspection-range-splits-unicode'. This fixes the failing start-boundary case ("xy😀z",3,2) while preserving the end-boundary and no-progress behavior.

Fix exact-json-scoring mutation: compare parsed JSON structurally with isDeepStrictEqual after normalizing object key order (objects unordered; arrays, types, missing/extra members remain significant). Preserve response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exact_json_match/answer_mismatch reasons.

Fix retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (Set size check) and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index, per evidence/contract.json and evidence/cases.json requirements. Export and unrelated behavior unchanged.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: enforce unique nonempty tool-call IDs within each exchange, require positional one-to-one tool-result pairing, and clamp the retention window so masking applies to all entries older than the recent tail.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: enforce unique nonempty tool-call IDs within each exchange, require positional one-to-one tool-result pairing, and clamp the retention window so masking applies to all entries older than the recent tail.

Repair the retention-long-window mutation: enforce call-ID uniqueness within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index, per the inspected contract requirements. Masking of old observations and all unrelated behavior preserved. Tests were not executed.

Fix controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (membership was insufficient). Unrelated behavior and exports preserved; tests and evidence untouched.

Compare parsed JSON structurally with isDeepStrictEqual instead of stringified JSON, so object member order is ignored while array order, types, and missing/extra members remain significant; response_not_text and invalid_json reasons preserved.
Reject an interior offset that splits a surrogate pair, and move an interior end backward so it never ends inside a pair; preserve all other behavior.
Repair slice-bounds mutation: reject interior surrogate-pair start offsets and move interior end offsets backward before the pair, preserving validation, empty-slice-at-EOF, and return fields.

Restore structural JSON equality: replace order-sensitive JSON.stringify comparison with isDeepStrictEqual on parsed values, preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the exact_json_match/answer_mismatch reasons.

Tighten tool-pair validation: require call IDs unique within each exchange and each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index, per cases-10/13 contract. Unrelated behavior and exports preserved.

Fixes pair-0/pair-4 by rejecting duplicate assistant tool_call IDs (unique-ID requirement), since positional pairing alone cannot distinguish cases where both calls and both results share one ID. Fixes empty-history by allowing an empty history with a non-negative recentCount and returning [] directly, instead of failing the recentCount <= history.length check for recentCount=1. All other behavior, masking, and export preserved.
